events.label: Hamas-led attack
events.description: Hamas-led attack on Israel, also known as Operation Al-Aqsa Flood; beginning of the war in Israel and Gaza.

events.label: Incitements since ICJ order
events.description: Incitements since the ICJ order to cease genocidal acts and incitement.

events.label: ICJ advisory opinion
events.description: The International Court of Justice delivered its advisory opinion on the legal consequences of Israeli policies and practices in the Occupied Palestinian Territory.

events.label: UNGA resolution ES-10/24
events.description: The UN General Assembly adopted resolution ES-10/24, demanding that Israel end its unlawful presence in the Occupied Palestinian Territory within 12 months.

events.label: ICC arrest warrants
events.description: The International Criminal Court issued arrest warrants for Benjamin Netanyahu, Yoav Gallant, and Hamas leader Mohammed Diab Ibrahim Al-Masri.

events.label: Israeli airstrikes in Gaza
events.description: Israeli airstrikes across the Gaza Strip in May 2025, amid an intensification of military operations.

events.label: Gaza City ground offensive
events.description: Beginning of the Israeli government ground offensive in Gaza City.
